made_for: the second light enrichment round: Animate the Background

jobs.name: tear-at-the-edge
jobs.sentence: Skip this and a moving background tears at the figure's edge.
jobs.claim: On BLUELINE shot 02, the project's own ink warp run with the infill step skipped drags a copy of the man's head out past his edge (up to 19 px in the 832 px frame, in 21 of the loop's 64 frames at the threshold used); the same warp over LaMa's plate leaves his edge clean to the eye. The claim is on the page; the mechanism is the project's (ink_flames.py: infill 'so the moving layer has no head to smear').
chain: hand: ink_flames (BLUELINE's own warp, run from this folder by ink_flames_here.py, paths changed only), twice: over the plate and over the un-infilled shot
LaMa: the clean plate, rerun through Shop/LaMa's lama_fill.py on the rebuilt shot with the project's mask (feather > 100, 11 px dilation)
Drawn SVG: overlay.svg (labels, crop box, the ring), rasterised by Playwright's Chromium with a transparent ground
hand: make.py lays the two crops and the thumbnail under the overlay and writes the animated WebP (64 frames, 70 ms, the project's timing)

notes: Placed on 2026-11-17 as a proposal in Animate the Background's rich face: the loop, with its peak frame held still beside it. Challenged once (remake the lines only), second verdict keep; the WebP never changed. The files under project/ are copies of BLUELINE's tracked files, used as inputs. See challenge.md beside this file.
